gates.note: spec_k1 (sequential): 2 base forwards/round + MTP. After the 2026-05-19 embed-first concat fix, official Qwen3.6 MTP can reach high accept in the sequential path, but net speedup requires the batched K=2 verifier to preserve the same numerical backend as T=1. spec_k1_batched (M5/M9): one K=2 forward + MTP with reject penalty = +1 T=1 forward; the current gate measures whether batched verify accept and TPS have caught up. spec_kN_batched is experimental: it validates the shared K=N verify/crop ABI, while draft quality depends on whether the sidecar was trained for chained drafts.
